# Apex & Axis
> Apex & Axis is a business architecture firm for solo operators. We diagnose and treat Founder-Dependency Syndrome — the structural failure that makes a one-person business collapse when the founder stops working. The firm rebuilds solo operations through four engine systems: Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Growth.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://apexandaxis.org/): Main site with FDS diagnosis, Four Engines framework, Axis Audit, Starter Kit, and Apex Vault.
- [About](https://apexandaxis.org/about/): Firm overview and positioning.
- [Services](https://apexandaxis.org/services/): Engine-level structural services.
- [Contact](https://apexandaxis.org/contact/): Entry points to Starter Kit, Apex Vault, and founder channels.
- [Axis Starter Kit](https://whop.com/joined/apex-axis/products/axis-starter-kit/): Free tier with Axis Audit, Content Multiplier, Axis Protocol, and Architect's Stack.
- [Apex Vault Blueprint](https://whop.com/joined/apex-axis/products/apex-vault-blueprint/): Paid tier ($9.99/mo) with complete operating framework for all four engines plus Operator's Guide.
